S-U-UI-11-04.name: generated:S-U-UI-11-04
S-U-UI-11-04.description:
A stale action is refused, not applied, after the backend state moves

risk: stale_state (priority P0)
purpose: Verify that an action generated from the exception detail screen cannot apply once the run's state has transitioned, and the payload is only built for the state the backend actually holds.
requirement: U-UI-11: the screen never shows a state the backend does not currently hold
product principle: operational_clarity
rationale: AC3 is load-bearing (weight 3): the payload snapshots state while the page reads live state, so the highest risk is the screen surfacing/acting on a state the backend already left.

generated at 2026-08-10T04:23:15+00:00 (stage=initial, wave 1)
